body:
The Lemurian Tide draws from the quiet intelligence of a sunken world—a place where water and stone met in perfect, prehistoric harmony. In the lore of the ancients, Lemuria was a civilization that lived entirely through the heart, and this bracelet is designed to reactivate that dormant blueprint within your own emotional body.

The combination of Pilbara Prase and Green Terra Agate holds the frequency of those fertile, ancient landscapes, offering a steady, nurturing energy that supports deep emotional renewal. These stones act as "sea-glass" for the soul, smoothing over the jagged edges of stress and trauma. Cream River Stones reflect the steady movement of Lemurian tides, reminding the body how to soften and return to a state of natural flow.

At the center of this activation is the DZI Agate. Known as the "Eye of the Ocean," it serves as a stabilizing force that maintains your awareness within the flow. It ensures that while your heart remains open and fluid, your energy stays contained and protected from external chaos.

This piece is for the modern seeker ready to reclaim the Lemurian frequency—one of softness, compassion, and emotional sovereignty. It is a reminder that true strength is found in allowing, and that the heart is the ultimate compass for navigating the shifting tides of the now.
